::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 28th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 43-44
:::

Dear Mr Macmillan,
I think of these three photographs the one in profile is <u>prettiest</u>, the full faced decidedly not good, but the third the most characteristic, and the position of the hand comes out the best.[^1]

The more I look at it the better I like it and see the superiority to the other two.

Here is a proof where I have added more than I hope to have to add to future ones. Shall I send the proofs to you or to the printer direct, if the last what is his address.

I am reading [les Miserables](other_books/otherbook_371.qmd), and of course am much struck with it

Yours very truly
C. M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Evidently portraits of [Florence Nightingale](people/person_1086.qmd) to be used for *A Book of Golden Deeds*.
